# Interview reference

The questionnaire `driftbench intake interview` writes from an approved map, and the owner answers in place for `intake from-interview`; see [from an interview](../generating.md#from-an-interview). The page lists every field, generated from the zod schemas the CLI uses.

* Keys are as written below. An unknown key is an error.
* Descriptions come from the schemas. An empty cell means the schema has no description for that field yet.

## Interview

The owner interview: the answers path (ii) of the reference set is built from.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `1` | yes |  | The version of the interview format, 1. |
| `agent` | string, not empty | yes |  | The agent the interview is about; the reference set built from it names the same agent. |
| `map` | string, not empty | yes |  | The approved map, as a path relative to this file. |
| `personas` | list of [Interview personas](#interview-personas), at least 1 item | yes |  | The kinds of user who write to the agent, one entry each. |
| `intents` | list of [Interview intents](#interview-intents), at least 1 item | yes |  | How often each intent of the map occurs, and which personas come with it. |
| `examples` | list of [Interview examples](#interview-examples), at least 1 item | yes |  | Example messages a user writes next at a stage, for one persona and one intent. |
| `never` | list of [Interview never](#interview-never) | no | `[]` | What users never do or say, one entry each. |
| `tone` | string | no | `` | How users write in general: length, politeness, typos, emoji, slang. |
| `languages` | list of [Interview languages](#interview-languages), at least 1 item | yes |  | The languages users write in, and how often each. |
| `channels` | list of [Interview channels](#interview-channels), at least 1 item | yes |  | How often users come through each channel of the map. |

## Interview personas

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` | yes |  | A short name for the persona, such as busy-parent. |
| `description` | string | yes |  | Who they are and what they want, in a sentence or two. |
| `share` | number, at least 0 or `null` | yes |  | How often this persona writes, relative to the other personas. |
| `map` | map of string to string | no | `{}` | The value of each persona dimension of the map that describes them. |
| `tone` | string | no | `` | How this persona writes: length, politeness, typos, emoji. |
| `languages` | list of strings | yes |  | The language codes this persona writes in, from languages. |
| `channels` | list of strings | yes |  | The channels this persona uses, from channels. |

## Interview intents

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | string, not empty | yes |  | A value of the intent dimension of the map. |
| `share` | number, at least 0 or `null` | yes |  | How often users come with this intent, relative to the other intents. |
| `personas` | list of strings, each matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` | no |  | The personas that come with it. Default: every persona. |

## Interview examples

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stage` | string, not empty | yes |  | A value of the stage dimension: where the agent is. |
| `intent` | string, not empty | yes |  | The intent of the user. |
| `persona` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` | yes |  | The persona who writes. |
| `lang` | string | no |  | The language. Default: the persona's first language. |
| `channel` | string | no |  | The channel. Default: the persona's first channel. |
| `turns` | list of strings | yes |  | What this user writes next at this stage, one message per item. |

## Interview never

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string, not empty | yes |  | Something users never do or say. |
| `match` | list of strings, each not empty | no | `[]` | Words or phrases that must never appear in a generated turn (case-insensitive). |

## Interview languages

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lang` | string, not empty | yes |  | A language code, such as en or nl. |
| `share` | number, at least 0 or `null` | yes |  | How often users write in it, relative to the other languages. |
| `map` | map of string to string | no | `{}` | The value of each persona dimension of the map this language falls under. |

## Interview channels

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | string, not empty | yes |  | A channel of the map. |
| `share` | number, at least 0 or `null` | yes |  | How often users come through it, relative to the other channels. |
